ValidationRule.description: Freight invoicing cases to be tagged to Freight Account (Only to users local region) CRM 7893 and CRM-8116
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName,'Freight_Invoicing'), NOT(ISBLANK( AccountId )), NOT( CONTAINS(Account.RecordTypeId, '01290000000ibKVAAY')), NOT( CONTAINS(Owner:User.Country,'AU')), NOT((ISPICKVAL(Account.Type, "Freight-Country") && CONTAINS(Owner:User.Country, Account.BillingCountry ))), $User.FirstName <> 'System Admin', $User.LastName <> 'Updates', TEXT($User.Freight_Department__c) <> 'Freight Support' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select only Freight Country Account in your local region, if not in AU.
